name: Nino Vaccarella
features: dark receding hair, aquiline nose, thin face, spectacles off the car, schoolmaster's bearing
bio: The flying headmaster of Palermo, who taught Latin during the week and knew every one of the Targa Florio's seven hundred corners. Won it three times, drove the works 512S in 1970, and was the one Ferrari driver the Sicilian crowd came to see.
